Name: Munchboi The Cat
Author: Aizu201
Description:
This mod replaces the cat sprite with my IRL ragdoll cat Munchboi.
He's a lazy giant chonk who speak in squeaks instead of meows and no cats want to be his friend because his giant paws scare them.
Please love him.



Joking aside, I replayed Stardew Valley after a long, long time and remembered that you can have a pet cat. So why not make a cat sprite of my favorite fluff boi? Yeah, and now I'm posting him here to spread the love to y'all Stardew Valley Fam.


How to install:
[list=1]
[*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ (see this [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started]page[/url]﻿ for installation guide).
[*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[*]Download this Mod. Unzip the file and drag the folder "[CP] Munchboi The Cat" to the game's "Mods" folder.
[*]Be sure that there's no other cat reskin mods installed (unless it's xnb mod. if you don't know what that is then don't worry about it).
[*]Run the game with SMAPI. If you see Munchboi as your cat then you have successfully installed this mod. :D
[/list]
